= S-411 2014 acceptance corpus

These are the unmodified files published at
https://www.bsis-ice.de/S411/Schemas/[the BSH S-411 schema distribution],
associated with JCOMM S-411 Edition 1.1.0 (June 2014).
The catalogue itself declares version 1.0.0 dated 2014-02-13; these are
separate version identifiers. No newer catalogue has been substituted.

`manifest.json` records source URLs, retrieval date, byte sizes, SHA-256
checksums and the complete local schema closure. No separate licence was
identified in the retrieved publication; publication alone does not establish
a redistribution licence.

The five source files total 226252 bytes. Keep their bytes unchanged.
The spec independently reads the source XML using namespace-aware XPath;
it does not use generated model output as its expected inventory.
The inventory is 28 feature types, 51 simple attributes, 6 complex attributes,
406 listed values, 131 feature attribute references and 12 complex attribute
references. All references resolve to catalogue attribute codes.

`catalogue.adoc` is a standalone Metanorma entry document;
`catalogue.liquid` renders features, referenced attributes and listed values.
`render.rb` registers the plugin preprocessor and streams the rendered Metanorma
XML. From the plugin repository, with the patched dependency selected:

[source,shell]
----
RUBYLIB=/path/to/patched-lutaml-model/lib bundle exec ruby -Ilib \
  spec/fixtures/lutaml/xml_data/s100/render.rb > /tmp/s411-catalogue.xml
----

This example requires the unreleased lutaml-model compiler candidate based on
0.8.176 (commit `c21b2f8d4e91efe6937b6c4637a5102249b8a7e5`)
with corrected `xs:ID` and `xs:IDREF` mappings.
Released 0.8.176 fails while loading the generated `ItemIdentifier` class.
No released minimum version containing this fix is claimed.
The acceptance spec asserts the complete feature and attribute inventory,
reference traversal, listed values, standalone clauses and rebuilt XML values.
